verdict.rationale: Floot's first-party docs say a plain-language description becomes a deployed full-stack app. Describing a feature to the assistant builds the endpoints, database tables and screens together, and the result is a real React + TypeScript app with pages, components and backend endpoints backed by managed Postgres. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that one prompt yields working frontend and backend together, and deeper documentation of how backend logic is generated from the prompt.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: Floot turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app — React + TypeScript frontend,
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
